name: corridor-intelligence-app
description: Branded chat front door to the Corridor Genie serving endpoint (traced, governed).
comment: ZERO runtime dependencies on purpose: the Databricks Apps build sandbox has no npm-registry egress, so any dependency hangs `npm install`. server.js uses only Node built-ins (http/fs; fetch is a Node 18+ global). The React frontend is pre-built locally into dist/ and shipped. To rebuild dist locally: `npm install --no-save vite @vitejs/plugin-react react react-dom react-markdown remark-gfm typescript @types/react @types/react-dom && npm run build`
